priorityList: Apply Poisons, maintain Slice and Dice, and enter Stealth before combat.
Use Kick to interrupt enemy spellcasting.
Use Deathmark when Garrote and Rupture are active and Kingsbane is ready or nearly ready.
Use Kingsbane while Deathmark is active and Envenom is up.
Use Vanish to apply or refresh empowered Garrotes via the Improved Garrote talent, especially during Deathmark.
Use Crimson Tempest as a priority if any targets in the pack are missing Garrote or Rupture dots.
Maintain Garrote on all targets by cycling through them, prioritizing targets where it is expiring or lacks the Stealth-empowered multiplier.
Maintain Rupture on all targets by cycling through them when at 5 or more Combo Points.
Use Fan of Knives as your primary Combo Point generator when 2 or more targets are present.
If the Darkest Night buff is active, only use finishing moves (Envenom or Rupture) when at maximum Combo Points.
Spend Combo Points on Envenom to maintain Implacable Tracker stacks (up to 4).
Use Envenom to prevent Energy capping if you are above 70% Energy.
Use Shiv as a builder if Darkest Night is active and you have 3 or fewer targets (requires Toxic Stiletto talent).
Use Thistle Tea if Energy falls below 50% or the fight is nearly over.
Activate offensive Trinkets and Racials (such as Blood Fury or Berserking) during your Deathmark and Kingsbane windows.
